content:
tara (Product Designer): quick check 1 compact prereq strip for private setup wizard. shows three compact chips: Network | Agent | Keys. click to expand inline details. prototype: https://figma.com/file/compact-strip-2

ben (PM): nice direction. question: what exact microcopy for the chips when green/yellow/red? keep short.

tara (Product Designer): proposal: 'Ready to proceed', 'Action suggested', 'Action required'. plus a short count: '1 issue of 4'.

liam (Frontend): implementation notes: chips will be <button> with aria-expanded + aria-controls, and an aria-live region for status updates. ensure focus outline is visible.

amar (SRE): when failing, show one prioritized remediation and one copyable command. redact secrets. link to KB for full steps.

a11y-bot: a11y nits: do not rely on color alone; include icon + text. contrast checks required. copy action should announce 'Copied to clipboard' via aria-live. ensure mobile touch targets >=44px.

ben (PM): decision: adopt the copy, chips collapsed by default, add 'Show issues only' toggle, owners: liam prototype, amar write KB snippet, tara update figma. target: PR by next week.

tara (Product Designer): thanks all 60 will post updated link when ready.
